StampShelf.HelpText.zh:
拖动印章可调整列表顺序，拖到快捷槽可固定或替换。

也可先选槽，再点击印章固定；再次点槽或按 Esc 取消选择。槽位右上角 × 只清空绑定，印章仍保留。

右键“取消固定”按 1～9、0 的顺序每次清除一个绑定。

选择印章后点“使用”或双击开始盖印。列表连续滚动，搜索按名称筛选。
StampShelf.HelpText.en:
Drag stamps to reorder the list or drop them onto a shortcut slot to pin or replace.

You can also select a slot and click a stamp. Click the slot again or press Esc to deselect. The corner × clears only that slot and keeps the stamp.

Right-click Unpin clears one binding at a time in 1–9,0 order.

Choose Use or double-click a stamp to start placing it. Scroll continuously through the list, or search by name.

StampShelf.EmptySlot.zh: 快捷槽 {0}：拖入印章，或先点选此槽再点下方印章
StampShelf.EmptySlot.en: Slot {0}: drag in a stamp, or select this slot and click a stamp below
